Dearest Triveni, My Dear Best Friend,
Happy Birthday to My Dear Best Friend Triveni!

Born on 11th March 2007, chinnappati nundi naa life lo unna most special person nuvvu.

Manam chinnappati nundi eppudu kalusthune unnam... kalisinappudalla chese allari, non-stop laughing fits, roasts, school & college kaburlu, and prathi chinna secret share chesukovadam naaku chala chala precious.

Okarini okaram tease chesukovadam, random ga call chesi sollu cheppadam, and life gurinchi discuss chesukovadam mana bond ni super special gaa unchuthundhi.

May this year bring you massive success, great health, and top achievements in your studies! Nuvvu anukune dreams anni fulfill avali, doctor gaa peddha level ki vellali ani manasara korukuntunna!

Always keep smiling like this Triveni. Happy Birthday with all my heart! ❤️
— Nee Best Friend Forever
